messages.subject: quasi-poisson
parts: Has anyone tried implementing quasi-poisson regression in NIMBLE as described in the attached? Would the correct approach for implementing this be via NIMBLE function(s). If so, has anyone written up the quasi-poisson for NIMBLE, or can anyone point me to an example set of functions for defining a distribution that's not already supported by NIMBLE?

messages.author: 63cc02caac0434cf
messages.subject: Re: quasi-poisson
parts:
You could reparametrize the negative binomial. 

If y~ dnegbin(prob = r/(1+r), size = r*u) then E[y]=u and V[y]=u*(1+1/r)
